name: LuxConnect DC2 (Bissen)
notes: 3, op der Poukewiss, ZAC Klengbousbierg, L-7795 Bissen; gross size 21,000 sqm; built 2012 (Baxtel); hosts LuxProvide MeluXina ecosystem. LuxConnect 2025 results announce continued Bissen investment to host the AI Factory (next-gen MeluXina).

name: Google Bissen data center (pipeline)
notes: ~34 ha farmland owned by Google since 2017; project once valued ~EUR 1B. Status 2026: Bissen council approved special development plan (PAP) Jan 2026; EIA public consultation closed 27 Mar 2026; building permit and water-management permit still required; no construction date announced (status.lu 2026-07-10). Building-permit application reportedly submitted Aug 2025, not approved (RTL 2025-11-18); Google began recruiting Jan 2026; Mouvement Ecologique threatens court action. NOT operational, NOT under construction, NOT a GCP region.
